title: Rock Cycle Quiz
description: Watched "The Rock Recycling Plan"? See how much you remember.

questions.question: Why does granite have relatively large crystals?
options: It cooled quickly at the surface
It was carried by a river
questions.explanation: Magma that cools slowly underground gives minerals plenty of time to grow large crystals, so granite is coarse-grained.

questions.question: Which type of rock is basalt?
questions.explanation: Basalt is an igneous rock formed when lava cools quickly at the surface, which is why its grains are so fine.

questions.question: Which type of rock usually preserves fossils?
questions.explanation: Remains of living things get buried along with sand and mud, so most fossils are found in sedimentary rocks.

questions.question: What does limestone turn into under high heat and pressure?
questions.explanation: Metamorphosed limestone becomes marble. Slate comes from shale.

questions.question: Does a rock melt when it becomes a metamorphic rock?
options: No, only its minerals and texture change
questions.explanation: Metamorphism happens in the solid state. If the rock melted completely it would become magma again, and later form an igneous rock.
